title: Clean Renewable Energy KK 1E to supply renewable power for JK Cement’s Muddapur cement plant
summary: Clean Renewable Energy KK 1E to supply renewable power for JK Cement’s Muddapur cement plant
body_markdown:
**India:** JK Cement plans to invest US$555,000 to obtain a 27% stake in Hero Future Energies subsidiary Clean Renewable Energy KK 1E. The utilities provider will then supply 99.4MW of solar and 26.4MW of wind power from an upcoming hybrid renewable power plant in Karnataka to JK Cement’s nearby Muddapur cement plant.


Renewables Now News has reported that JK Cement previously contracted for a 70MW solar power supply for its Nimbahera cement plant in Rajasthan from Oriana Power.
